body:
Propose these two decisions with `task decision`, one per call, and the human approves or rejects each one. No code changes. A planning (investigate) run can do this and then complete the task.

**1. A system review log is one file only Solace writes** (feature:21d501a74aec4f44)
- Each project's top folder has one `SYSTEMREVIEWS.md`, created the same way as `DECISIONS.md` (D-254). An existing file is kept.
- Agents read it, but no `write`, `remove` or `move` changes it. Only Solace adds to it.
- Each completed system review adds one entry with its review kinds, date, version reviewed and finding tasks.
- Review run conversations stay local, like other runs (D-261).
- Why: a shared record agents can't forge shows when each review was done and what it found, and a later build check can rely on it.

**2. Every release gets a shared what's-new summary, made automatically** (feature:cc8b45a04bb07bfe)
- When a release is made, Solace writes a short summary and fuller details from the notes of the tasks it includes, with no approval step.
- The summary and details are shared with the project. The task notes themselves stay private (D-261 point 4).
- This changes "notes are never drafted on their own" in feature:3637869b15413bc5 for these summaries only. The release notes humans ask for and approve stay as they are.
- Why: teammates get briefed quickly on what changed since their last release, without anyone's private task conversations being shared.

Done when: both have been proposed and the human has answered each.
title: decisions: record system reviews and summaries
